title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WateringSystem
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WateringSystem. A class to describe a system that dispenses or irrigates water. Subclass of ssn:System (W3C SSN, not modeled here); inherited ssn:System vocabulary (ssn:implements, generic composition semantics) is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9, which has sub-systems (ssn:hasSubSystem) including SoilTensiometer sensors.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WateringSystem'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. A human-readable name for this watering system, e.g. 'ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01'.

hasSubSystem.description: Relationship. ssn:hasSubSystem (inverse: ssn:deployedSystem context). The components of this watering system, e.g. WateringGun, WateringValve and SoilTensiometer instances.

status.description: Property. The current operational state of the watering system.

isHostedBy.description: Relationship. sosa:isHostedBy (inverse: sosa:hosts). The Platform hosting this system.
